lines.trans: Oh my goodness, it is Christophe Lambert!
Hello Noemie! How are you doing?
I am doing very well, thank you very much.
Can I take a photo with you?
Yes, no problem with pleasure!
I am a very big fan.
Me too, I am very friendly.
Get closer. Big smile!
Hi Christophe! Come this way.
Mathias! It is a pleasure to see you.
The director wants you for this role.
Read the script tonight.
All right, I will read it quickly.
See you later Mathias. Goodbye!

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

meanings.en: au contraire = on the contrary; au revoir = goodbye

examples.text: Tu déjeunes aussi avec Dany Boon.
examples.trans: You're also having lunch with Dany Boon.
You know a lot of people.

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of
the standard greeting during the day
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel
comment ça va? = how are you?

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

examples.trans: The fans are starting to protest.

meanings.note: quelle heure est-il? = what time is it?
à tout à l'heure = see you later
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà
merci beaucoup = thank you very much

examples.text: Tu as mis ta photo dans cette enveloppe?
examples.trans: Did you put your photo in this envelope?

examples.text: Par exemple, le contrat de Canet.

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Ça fait plaisir à ma famille.

meanings.en: faire plaisir à = to please, to make happy

meanings.note: pronounced plys when it means 'more' at the end

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

examples.trans: I can't take it any more.

meanings.note: je peux t'appeler? = may I call you?
je n'en peux plus = I can't take any more

examples.trans: I want to see this film again.

meanings.en: se revoir: to see each other again
meanings.note: on se reverra: we'll meet again

meanings.en: part, role (in a film or play)

examples.text: Je ne peux pas venir ce soir.
J'aime le regard et le sourire.
examples.trans: I like the look and the smile.

meanings.note: before the verb; t' before a vowel

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
venir de: je viens de la Côte d'Azur
venir de + infinitive: je viens d'arriver = I've just arrived
+ noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir
je vous rappelle = I'll call you back
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
